note: Every value here is read at runtime. The SRS states evaluators may demand a changed confidence threshold live, so no threshold may ever be a literal in code. src/inference and src/services read this file; the admin UI edits it.

consistency.comment: Difference = |python_top_confidence - gtm_top_confidence|. Above weak_match_max_diff and the models disagree on class => Model Disagreement. Same class but a large gap => Weak Match. Below min_confidence on both => Uncertain Result.

repeat_detection.comment: SRS Step 15. A single unstable prediction must not raise a critical alert.

robustness.comment: Noise-robustness conditions. A probe scores DEGRADED test audio, so its numbers are not test accuracy and meets_floors() refuses to certify them. Hard rule: the probe runs ONCE, after python_models/selection.json is frozen. Choosing a model because it wins under noise would leak the test split into the selection, and the reported test accuracy would no longer be an unbiased estimate.
